purpose: Isolate content-dependent access over depth from static reweighting, block summarization, and a depth/width geometry change.

evidence_basis.supported: content-dependent softmax depth attention outperforms static weights in the reported study; one head, RMS-normalized keys, zero pseudo-query initialization, and block summaries are supported ablations
evidence_basis.not_transferred: quality gains, 1.25x compute advantage, approximately eight blocks, and below-2% inference overhead

evidence_basis.supported: Block AttnRes can coexist with a KDA/global hybrid and requires explicit sharding/checkpointing
evidence_basis.not_transferred: K3 whole-system gains or its block size 12 as Speck's optimum

evidence_basis.supported: depth routing is isolated only after a conservative or selected sequence parent and must be followed by block-count and depth/width studies
evidence_basis.not_transferred: a selected AttnRes formulation or geometry

ordered_prerequisites: select or freeze one conservative sequence parent and keep its operators fixed
materialize Speck's residual module graph and source identities independently of model execution
implement reference Full and Block AttnRes plus static controls
qualify forward, backward, chunking, checkpoint, export, and incremental behavior
freeze parameter/FLOP matching, analysis, activation-memory, and depth diagnostics before training

module_graph.module_order: sequence stage followed by feed-forward stage within every logical block
module_graph.source_updates: the output update of every completed residual module in execution order
module_graph.rule: AttnRes partitions and attends over 40 residual modules, not the 20 logical-block labels

reference_equations.full_sources: embedding plus every completed module update before module j
reference_equations.full_keys: RMSNorm each source independently with one shared per-module key normalization rule
reference_equations.full_query: one learned hidden-size pseudo-query per module, initialized exactly to zero
reference_equations.full_weights: one softmax head over source depth; weights are token-dependent through query/key dot products even though the pseudo-query is input-independent
reference_equations.full_input: softmax-weighted sum of unnormalized source values
reference_equations.block_sources: embedding, every completed block sum, and the current block's partial sum after its first module
reference_equations.block_update: online block sums preserve exact module order; two-phase or chunked execution must equal the reference source set and softmax

initial_isolation_arms.definition: learn one token-independent softmax logit per available depth source with the same source set and parameter-matched budget
initial_isolation_arms.purpose: test whether any gain requires content dependence rather than learned static depth mixing

initial_isolation_arms.maximum_sources_reason: embedding plus seven completed blocks plus one current partial block at modules after the first within the eighth block

fixed_attnres_choices.reason: the cited controlled ablations support these choices; changing any requires a versioned local mechanism contract rather than entering the main isolation grid

correctness_before_training: explicit small-tensor Full and Block reference equations
static and content-dependent source identity/order checks
zero-query initialization identity and deterministic source weights
online block-update parity across arbitrary module chunks
full prefill, chunked prefill, and one-token decode parity
checkpoint/resume and Transformers export round trip
no change to sequence KV or recurrent persistent state
activation/source storage and temporary workspace accounting

parameter_costs_to_report: any projection or gate introduced by implementation
matching.compensation: adjust every dense FFN width uniformly where possible; retain exact residual mismatch and a fixed-analytic-FLOP view
fixed_within_cell: depth and width for initial isolation

block_count_successor.partition_rule: for N blocks over M=40 modules, boundary i is floor(i*M/N) for i=0..N; adjacent block sizes may differ by at most one
block_count_successor.full_depth_control: Full AttnRes with 40 individual module updates
block_count_successor.selection: choose the smallest summary count passing every quality/gradient-flow constraint and lying on the activation/communication frontier

depth_width_successor.minimum_grid: three depths by three widths for standard residual and the selected AttnRes formulation
depth_width_successor.budget: matched active parameters and training compute with identical data/tuning budget
depth_width_successor.reason: AttnRes changes the reported compute-optimal depth/width ratio; comparing only at the standard-residual optimum is not a fair architecture decision
requirements: one held-out geometry or compute point
same optimizer-tuning budget for both residual rules

mechanistic_diagnostics: hidden and residual RMS by module depth
module update fraction relative to routed input
gradient norm by module and source age
source weights and entropy by token/module
effective source age and embedding reliance
source-weight response to token type, position, and long-context load
activation memory, recomputation, and pipeline communication
causal interventions that remove or replace selected old sources

decision_contract.quality: fixed-token aggregate and every-source non-inferiority is mandatory
decision_contract.claimed_mechanism: Full or Block AttnRes must beat the static-depth control on a predeclared content-dependence diagnostic
decision_contract.efficiency: fixed-analytic-compute loss or time-to-locked-quality must improve by at least 10% with a lower one-sided paired 95% bound clearing the threshold
decision_contract.systems: activation/recomputation and realized train/prefill/decode overhead are hard constraints; analytic depth FLOPs alone are insufficient
decision_contract.promotion: requires the block-count and depth/width successors plus medium-scale transfer under architecture-promotion-v1

decision.next_action: after the sequence parent is fixed, materialize only the 40-module source graph and small-tensor reference equations
